description: Shared education foundation for reusable state schemas, monitoring utilities, and reference specifications. This pack is a dependency surface for department education packs, not a learner-facing domain.

invariants.description: Foundation sessions must not directly mutate learner state or issue instructional decisions.
Foundation artifacts must remain shared primitives and must not embed department-specific policy thresholds without explicit department ownership.

standing_orders.description: Stop any attempted state mutation and route the work to the owning department model-pack.
Ask the author to identify whether the artifact belongs in foundation or a department pack.

escalation_triggers.condition: A shared foundation artifact attempts to own learner-facing policy, curriculum thresholds, or direct state mutation.
